title: Expedition 66 SpaceX Dragon CRS-24 Cargo Ship Departs International Space Station - Jan. 21, 2022
description: Loaded with scientific experiments and supplies, the unpiloted SpaceX Cargo Dragon undocked from the International Space Station Jan. 23, completing a month-long mission to the outpost for the company’s 24th commercial resupply services mission for NASA. The SpaceX spacecraft undocked from the zenith port of the Harmony module, headed for a splashdown off the coast of Florida Jan. 24 to complete its flight that delivered several tons of experiments and hardware to the station.  Get the latest from NASA delivered every week. Subscribe here: www.nasa.gov/subscribe
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
